device.description: 12-bit 500 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with internal reference and 12-bit parallel interface
device.note: ads7852.pdf (SBAS111C) p.2 channel selection table, p.3 electrical characteristics (VSS 4.75-5.25 V, logic levels, straight binary, 13.5 clock conversion), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, p.10 basic operation / starting a conversion / channel addressing, p.11 Figure 2 write/read timing and Table I output codes, p.12 power-down (Table II)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the channel address A2 A1 A0 latched on the WR rising edge with CS low (p.10); reset value not documented

commands.name: Start Conversion (CS + WR)
commands.note: p.2 channel selection: A2 A1 A0 = 000..111 select AIN0..AIN7; the data pins are outputs and carry nothing in

pages: p.2 (channel selection), p.3 (electrical characteristics), p.4 (pins), p.10 (operation, channel addressing), p.11 (Figure 2 timing: tCONV 1.75 us, t9 bus access 30 ns, t10 relinquish; Table I codes), p.12 (Table II power-down)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer and the internal 2.5 V reference / VREF input (the result is always the 0 V code 000h)

the conversion is clocked by the external CLK (13.5 clocks after the first CLK rising edge following WR low); the model starts it when the write ends and uses the 1.75 us maximum tCONV at fCLK = 8 MHz
BUSY goes low 20 ns after WR falling (model: at the end of the write)
Nap and Sleep power-down entered on the RD rising edge with A1/A0 (Table II) and wake-up
outputs are tri-stated when CS and WR start a conversion; reading during a conversion is not defined by the datasheet (the model returns the 0 V code)
bus float: Figure 2 lists t10 bus relinquish 5 ns (min column) while the text says data stays valid 20 ns after CS/RD rise; tDf = 20 ns
variants: ADS7852Y and ADS7852YB (higher linearity grade) share the spec.
